<script setup lang="ts">
import type { DialogRootEmits, DialogRootProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/dialog'
import { Dialog } from '@vase-ui/vue/dialog'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ DialogRootProps {}
interface Emits extends /* @vue-ignore */ DialogRootEmits {}

defineProps<Props>()
defineEmits<Emits>()
</script>

<template>
  <Dialog.Root v-slot="slotProps">
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </Dialog.Root>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { DialogCloseProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/dialog'
import { Dialog } from '@vase-ui/vue/dialog'
import { computed, useTemplateRef } from 'vue'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ DialogCloseProps {}

defineProps<Props>()

const part = useTemplateRef<{ element: Element | null }>('part')
// An outer trigger that renders this wrapper in its element slot reads the element of the part.
defineExpose({ element: computed(() => part.value?.element ?? null) })
</script>

<template>
  <Dialog.Close ref="part" data-slot="dialog-close">
    <template v-if="$slots.element" #element="slotProps">
      <slot name="element" v-bind="slotProps" />
    </template>
    <slot />
  </Dialog.Close>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { DialogDescriptionProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/dialog'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { Dialog } from '@vase-ui/vue/dialog'
import { cn } from 'cn'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ DialogDescriptionProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}

const props = defineProps<Props>()
</script>

<template>
  <Dialog.Description
    data-slot="dialog-description"
    :class="cn('text-muted-foreground *:[a]:hover:text-foreground text-xs/relaxed *:[a]:underline *:[a]:underline-offset-3', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </Dialog.Description>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { DialogBackdropProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/dialog'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { Dialog } from '@vase-ui/vue/dialog'
import { cn } from 'cn'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ DialogBackdropProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
})

const props = defineProps<Props>()

function onBeforeEnter(el: Element) {
  el.removeAttribute('data-closed')
  el.setAttribute('data-open', '')
}

function onBeforeLeave(el: Element) {
  el.removeAttribute('data-open')
  el.setAttribute('data-closed', '')
}
</script>

<template>
  <Transition @before-enter="onBeforeEnter" @before-leave="onBeforeLeave">
    <Dialog.Backdrop
      data-slot="dialog-overlay"
      v-bind="$attrs"
      :class="cn('data-open:animate-in data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-open:fade-in-0 bg-black/80 duration-100 supports-backdrop-filter:backdrop-blur-xs fixed inset-0 isolate z-50', props.class)"
    >
      <slot />
    </Dialog.Backdrop>
  </Transition>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { DialogTitleProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/dialog'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { Dialog } from '@vase-ui/vue/dialog'
import { cn } from 'cn'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ DialogTitleProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}

const props = defineProps<Props>()
</script>

<template>
  <Dialog.Title
    data-slot="dialog-title"
    :class="cn('text-sm font-medium cn-font-heading', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </Dialog.Title>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { DialogTriggerProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/dialog'
import { Dialog } from '@vase-ui/vue/dialog'
import { computed, useTemplateRef } from 'vue'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ DialogTriggerProps {}

defineProps<Props>()

const part = useTemplateRef<{ element: Element | null }>('part')
// An outer trigger that renders this wrapper in its element slot reads the element of the part.
defineExpose({ element: computed(() => part.value?.element ?? null) })
</script>

<template>
  <Dialog.Trigger ref="part" data-slot="dialog-trigger">
    <template v-if="$slots.element" #element="slotProps">
      <slot name="element" v-bind="slotProps" />
    </template>
    <slot />
  </Dialog.Trigger>
</template>

export { default as Dialog } from './Dialog.vue'
export { default as DialogClose } from './DialogClose.vue'
export { default as DialogContent } from './DialogContent.vue'
export { default as DialogDescription } from './DialogDescription.vue'
export { default as DialogFooter } from './DialogFooter.vue'
export { default as DialogHeader } from './DialogHeader.vue'
export { default as DialogOverlay } from './DialogOverlay.vue'
export { default as DialogScrollContent } from './DialogScrollContent.vue'
export { default as DialogTitle } from './DialogTitle.vue'
export { default as DialogTrigger } from './DialogTrigger.vue'
